Overview

Owerri is a city in Imo with a population of 540,000. The capital of Imo State in southeastern Nigeria, known for its hospitality, cultural festivals, and educational institutions. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7b growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. The population skews young, with a median age of 18.0.
